where: census rows of tempo's build (port27/tempo-run/build-census-g044908.txt) whose example bodies live in crates not unpacked anywhere readable
what: reducing a census row needs the dependency's source; only a part of tempo's dependency set is unpacked (port27/procs-1116/d58/work2/vendor has hashbrown, mime_guess, ruint and others), and alloy-sol-types, jsonwebtoken, der and the crate defining ArbitraryInt are not on disk: their text is only in blaze's store records. jsonwebtoken's `Enc::deserialize` had to be read on docs.rs; the census example's text excerpt (40 bytes) is not enough to reduce a body
cost: about half an hour of searching, and two rows (ArbitraryInt, Result<Length>) left unreduced
cause: the census prints a body's item path and a short excerpt, not the crate version or its file; no tool dumps a record's source text by item path
whys: the census was built for counting, not for reducing
class: evidence a lane needs that only the store holds
prevention: wanted: the census names each example's crate, version and file:line, or a `blaze debug source <item path>` that prints a record's text
annoyance: Grep and Glob were not available in this lane's tool set, so read-only searches went through Bash
workaround: docs.rs source pages for published crates
